en.sayed-athar-husain-rizvi-&-sayed-maqs: 1.  Imam Ja’far Sadiq (a.s.) says that the Messenger of Allah (s.a.w.s.) used to wash his head with Jujube leaves and say, “Wash your head with jujube leaves for all the angels and prophets  consider  this  holy.
Allah  will  keep  away  evil thoughts  of  Shaitaan  for  seventy  days  from  the  one  who washes  his  head  with  jujube  leaves.
and one who does not commit sins will enter Paradise.”
